testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate to the ends of a staged target list: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/ribbon-customization-identity-support/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1658:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate to the ends of a staged target list ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target ✔ And "2-D Drawing", "2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are staged in that order ✔ And all three staged rows have Large and Text unchecked ✔ When the user selects "3D Annotations" in the target list and presses Home ✔ Then "2-D Drawing" is highlighted ✔ When the user presses End ✔ Then "3D Annotations" is highlighted ✔ And the three rows remain in their original order with their display options unchecked ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes without applying the staged commands
